name: LoopGuard
description: Detect stuck AI agents without treating every retry as a loop.

instructions: LoopGuard is a Python runtime guardrail SDK. Install loopguard-runtime and import loopguard. Use /getting-started and /guides/integration for application code.

Use the Concepts section for agent loops, tests versus traces versus evals, and trajectory/convergence. The convergence helper compares counts without checking success; LoopGuard events are not OpenTelemetry spans. Distinguish these general concepts from implemented SDK features.

The exact, semantic, calc, and trap UI examples illustrate Python SDK detection behavior. Read /demo/scenarios for runnable SDK examples and /guides/integration to attach callbacks or inspect streamed updates.
These docs follow the checkout. PyPI 0.2.1 lacks Gemini support, controlled demo scenarios, and additional decision display fields; check /development/status before describing release capabilities.
Repetition alone does not force STOP. REPLAN and PAUSE are recorded recommendations. Observe-only mode records decisions without raising. Follow /guides/integration for interrupt propagation.
Use the Python API, CLI, and configuration references for supported names and flags. Screenshots illustrate observed runs, not guaranteed stop counts or benchmark results.
